# Online-Ruler.Onl

Canonical site: https://www.online-ruler.onl/

Online-Ruler.Onl is a free browser-based screen ruler. The initial scale is an estimate. Users must calibrate the current display with a standard 85.60 mm ID-1 bank card or a manufacturer-listed display diagonal before relying on physical-size readings. Browser zoom should remain at 100%. Critical measurements require a suitable certified physical instrument.

## Primary pages

- Screen ruler and calibration: https://www.online-ruler.onl/
- Printable ruler with 100 mm scale check: https://www.online-ruler.onl/print-ruler

## Editorial notes

Measurement content is maintained by the Online Ruler Editorial Team. Standards-based unit definitions prioritize primary sources from NIST and BIPM. Corrections can be submitted through https://www.online-ruler.onl/contact.
